name: Corsa Performance Closed Box Cold Air Intake with Donaldson PowerCore Dry Filter (19-26 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: DR1VR
visible.title: HP gains and sound.
visible.body: Good HP gains, fit and looks good. Nice sound with AWE exhaust.
visible.product: Corsa Performance Closed Box Cold Air Intake with DryTech 3D Dry Filter (19-26 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: jaredw
visible.title: Corsa cold air intake
visible.body: Pretty easy to install and you can tell the difference immediately. Love the clear top definitely able to tell how filthy it is and makes for easy filter removal
visible.product: Corsa Performance Closed Box Cold Air Intake with DryTech 3D Dry Filter (19-26 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Elijah
visible.title: Check Engine Light
visible.body: Easy Install ill give it that, but this caused low RPMs and P0106, P0171,P0174 Codes to come up. Will be going back to stock intake.
visible.product: Corsa Performance Closed Box Cold Air Intake with DryTech 3D Dry Filter (19-26 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Kolby
visible.title: Easy Install and Great Performance
visible.body: This cold air intake was super easy to install. If this is the only item being installed, I'd say it could be done in 1 hr. I installed mine along with a new throttle body, throttle body spacer, and oil catch can...so it took a bit longer to do it. It feels like there is much more performance, but it is likely the combination of upgrades that I made all at once. I'm very satisfied with this purchase.
visible.product: Corsa Performance Closed Box Cold Air Intake with Donaldson PowerCore Dry Filter (19-26 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Rex Hamilton
visible.title: corsa cold air box
visible.body: quick shipping. it came with no packing slip, which wouldn’t allow me to get the directions so i watched the install video. just a little fyi the 2026 trail boss isn’t an 8mm. haven’t driven the truck much after install , im sure it will sound great corsa is a great product.
visible.product: Corsa Performance Closed Box Cold Air Intake with MaxFlow 5 Oiled Filter (19-26 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Dan
visible.title: Cords cold air
visible.body: Very nice product, good materials and noticed better throttle response, recommend performance air Flo sensor.
visible.product: Corsa Performance Closed Box Cold Air Intake with MaxFlow 5 Oiled Filter (19-26 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Frankie
visible.title: Simple to install
visible.body: Everything fit perfectly. The old intake manifold was a little tough to remove. The directions were very clear.
visible.product: Corsa Performance Closed Box Cold Air Intake with Donaldson PowerCore Dry Filter (19-26 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Joshua
visible.title: Highly recommend this product to anyone
visible.body: It was very easy to install took about 30 mins. Don’t see so much difference in power but it does sound way better when you step on it
visible.product: Corsa Performance Closed Box Cold Air Intake with Donaldson PowerCore Dry Filter (19-26 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: quietguy47
visible.title: Easy install
visible.body: Easy install, took maybe 20 minutes. Looks way better than the stock crap, better throttle response and more sound. The intake tube could be an inch longer on the air box side and it would be a better fit though.
visible.product: Corsa Performance Closed Box Cold Air Intake with Donaldson PowerCore Dry Filter (19-26 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: 2019custom
visible.title: It’s alive!
visible.body: Another great product from Corsa! Was simple and really effortless install. Right off back it’s not OMG HP but do notice on take off and even little up top cruising down highway. Would Highly recommend!
visible.product: Corsa Performance Closed Box Cold Air Intake with Donaldson PowerCore Dry Filter (19-26 5.3L Silverado 1500)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: patrickchristensen860@gmail.com
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Haven't noticed gains
low_same_part_other_truck.body: The only complaint I have is quality control should have better before shipping out product. The cover plate where 1 of the screws in the corner is cracked right out the box. No i didn't send it back because they would have said I over tightened the screw. Just superglue the Crack. Would have given it a 5 star overall rating
low_same_part_other_truck.product: Corsa Performance Closed Box Cold Air Intake with Donaldson PowerCore Dry Filter (19-24 5.7L RAM 1500)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: RQ
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Corsa volant
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Bought this corsa CAI for my 5.3L 2018 silverado ... first off the box said corsa ... the intake tube, filter, and plexiglass cover said volant. I would have just spent 50$ less if I knew I were getting a volant... also the silicone sleeve that attaches to the intake tube and MAF sensor should have been a reducer coupling it was not.... it was a tight fit over the intake tube thought I would have to buy a different piece. Also it didnt include the CARB decal as I am in CALI and have strict emission laws. Would not buy again ... does not include hose clamps either for the intake hoses.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: Corsa Performance Closed Box Cold Air Intake with Donaldson PowerCore Dry Filter (14-18 5.3L Silverado 1500)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Mikess
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Cold air intake
low_same_part_other_truck.body: I really thought you would hear this intake more. I also thought you would get a little better fuel mileage. The only postive is it looks nice under the hood and the filter won't need to be changed for 100000 miles.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: Corsa Performance Closed Box Cold Air Intake with Donaldson PowerCore Dry Filter (19-26 6.2L Silverado 1500)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: OnCapeCod
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Went with the Donaldson filter
low_same_part_other_truck.body: The crankcase vent hose is just a piece of heater hose and fits too loose on the valve cover fitting requiring a hose clamp (not provided). Not convinced yet of any power gain although the fuel trims probably need to recalibrate so we'll see.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: Corsa Performance Closed Box Cold Air Intake with Donaldson PowerCore Dry Filter (19-26 5.3L Sierra 1500)
